steps.name: gather_photos
steps.instruction: Ask the customer for photos of the damaged or defective product and packaging if no photos are on file.

steps.name: verify_order_details
steps.instruction: Look up the order to confirm the item, brand, category, line total and days since order.

steps.name: review_photos
steps.instruction: Review the customer's photos to confirm the item arrived damaged on arrival or failed to perform.

steps.name: check_guarantee_and_return_eligibility
steps.instruction: Determine whether a lifetime guarantee applies (router bits, TopSlide/Centerline drawer slides) and whether the item is non-returnable (Laguna/Sawstop power tools, clearance/final sale, software or plans). Guarantee replacements apply regardless of proof of purchase. Shipping charges are waived when the item is damaged or defective.

steps.name: decide_remedy
steps.instruction: If the item is covered by a lifetime guarantee, approve replacement. If the item is non-returnable and not defective-covered, deny. Otherwise approve replacement for damaged or defective items.

steps.name: authorize_and_issue_replacement
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue the replacement (or refund in rare cases) and provide the customer confirmation.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: replacement
outcomes.condition: Damaged or defective item with photos, returnable or covered by lifetime guarantee

outcomes.remedy: none
outcomes.condition: Item is Laguna or Sawstop power tool, clearance/final sale, software or downloadable plan, and not defective

outcomes.remedy: refund
outcomes.condition: Item is defective or damaged and a refund is requested in place of replacement

steps.name: Verify order and proof of purchase
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm valid proof of purchase exists. If no receipt, deny under RK-RET-3.

steps.name: Gather item condition
steps.instruction: Ask the customer whether the item is unopened and unused and confirm the item details needed for the ruling.

steps.name: Check return window and item eligibility
steps.instruction: Confirm the purchase is within 90 days, and that the item is not clearance or final sale, software or downloadable plans, or a Laguna or Sawstop power tool.

steps.name: Check power tool and packaging conditions
steps.instruction: For power tools, confirm the item is unused and in original packaging and that authorization is required before any return is processed.

steps.name: Decide ruling and rewards adjustment
steps.instruction: Issue the deterministic ruling. Where a promotional Rewards Card was used, void it if unused or reduce the refund by the amount redeemed.

steps.name: Execute remedy
steps.instruction: After authorization, send the return label and issue the full refund, partial refund, or store credit according to the ruling.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Deny the return and explain the proof of purchase requirement
outcomes.condition: No valid proof of purchase

outcomes.remedy: Deny the return as non-returnable
outcomes.condition: Clearance, final sale, software, or downloadable plans

outcomes.remedy: Deny the return as non-returnable
outcomes.condition: Laguna or Sawstop power tool

outcomes.remedy: Issue full refund or store credit and send return label; void or reduce by Rewards Card amount if applicable
outcomes.condition: Eligible, within 90 days, unused and unopened, with receipt

outcomes.remedy: Escalate to supervisor for authorization; deny if item is used or not in original packaging
outcomes.condition: Power tool return without authorization or not in original packaging

steps.name: Collect failure details
steps.instruction: Ask the customer for the product name, a description of how it failed, and approximate purchase date. A receipt is not required for covered items.

steps.name: Verify order record
steps.instruction: Look up the order or product record to confirm the item and whether it carries the lifetime guarantee.

steps.name: Check exclusions
steps.instruction: Determine whether the item is a power tool or sold as final sale, since these exclude it from return or replacement handling.

steps.name: Decide guarantee eligibility
steps.instruction: If the item is a Rockler router bit or a TopSlide/Centerline Lifetime drawer slide that failed to perform, it is covered for replacement with no proof of purchase required.

steps.name: Authorize and issue replacement
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue a free replacement of the covered item.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: issue free replacement
outcomes.condition: Item is a Rockler router bit or TopSlide/Centerline Lifetime drawer slide that failed, regardless of receipt

outcomes.remedy: explain non-returnable status and do not process a return
outcomes.condition: Item is a Laguna or Sawstop power tool

outcomes.remedy: explain final sale status and do not process a return
outcomes.condition: Item is clearance and sold as final sale

steps.name: Verify order and shipping status
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm whether it has shipped or been picked up and whether any item is backordered.

steps.name: Gather proof of purchase and item condition
steps.instruction: Ask the customer whether they have a valid receipt and, if the item is not cancellable, whether it is unopened and unused.

steps.name: Gather item details
steps.instruction: Confirm the item brand, category, line total and whether it is a power tool or marked final sale.

steps.name: Check cancellation and return eligibility
steps.instruction: If the order has not shipped, the cancellation is allowed. If it has shipped, evaluate return eligibility against the return window, proof of purchase, final sale, non-returnable brands and power tool authorization rules.

steps.name: Determine refund adjustment for rewards cards
steps.instruction: If the original transaction included promotional Rewards Cards, void unused cards or reduce the refund by the amount redeemed.

steps.name: Execute cancellation, refund, store credit or denial
steps.instruction: After authorization where required, cancel the order or issue the refund or store credit per the ruling; otherwise deny and explain the policy basis to the customer.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Cancel the order and refund the full amount, adjusted for any promotional Rewards Card.
outcomes.condition: Order not yet picked up or shipped

outcomes.remedy: Issue refund within the return window, adjusted for any promotional Rewards Card.
outcomes.condition: Order shipped or too late to cancel, item returnable with valid receipt, unopened or unused, not final sale, not non-returnable brand

outcomes.remedy: Issue store credit in place of cash refund.
outcomes.condition: Returnable item where store credit is the chosen remedy

outcomes.remedy: Deny the request and cite the specific policy that applies.
outcomes.condition: No valid proof of purchase, outside return window, final sale or clearance, non-returnable brand or software, or power tool without authorization

steps.name: Verify backorder status
steps.instruction: Look up the customer's order and confirm whether the item in the inquiry is on backorder.

steps.name: Check backorder policy
steps.instruction: Evaluate whether the out-of-stock item is held on backorder with the rest of the order placed.

steps.name: Check return restrictions if raised
steps.instruction: Only if the customer's request also involves returning or cancelling the item, evaluate final-sale, clearance, and Laguna or Sawstop power tool restrictions.

steps.name: Decide ETA eligibility
steps.instruction: If the item is on backorder, approve and provide the estimated ship date. If it is not on backorder, deny the ETA request.

steps.name: Send ETA reply
steps.instruction: Draft and send the reply with the estimated ship date for the backordered item.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: provide the estimated ship date for the backordered item
outcomes.condition: order.is_backordered is true

outcomes.remedy: explain that the item is not on backorder and no ETA applies
outcomes.condition: order.is_backordered is false

outcomes.remedy: decline the return and explain the final-sale terms
outcomes.condition: request includes a return of a final-sale or clearance item

outcomes.remedy: decline the return because the brand is non-returnable
outcomes.condition: request includes a return of a Laguna or Sawstop power tool

steps.name: Verify order shipped status
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm whether it has already shipped; if it has not shipped, the address change is handled as a pre-shipment edit outside this procedure.

steps.name: Gather item details
steps.instruction: Ask the customer which item(s) they want redirected or returned and confirm the desired outcome (new address is not possible after shipment; they may choose return, store credit, or carrier contact).

steps.name: Check return eligibility policy
steps.instruction: Evaluate whether the shipped items are eligible for return under the returns policy, considering Laguna/Sawstop power tool exclusions, clearance final-sale status, and non-returnable software or plans.

steps.name: Decide ruling
steps.instruction: Deny the address change request, since the order has shipped. If items are returnable, offer a return; if not returnable, offer store credit where policy allows or direct the customer to carrier contact.

steps.name: Issue remedy
steps.instruction: Execute the approved remedy: send a return label, issue a refund, or issue store credit, only after authorization.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Decline redirect; offer return, store credit, or carrier contact
outcomes.condition: Order has shipped and address change requested

outcomes.remedy: No return; offer store credit or carrier contact
outcomes.condition: Shipped item is a Laguna or Sawstop power tool

outcomes.remedy: No return; offer store credit or carrier contact
outcomes.condition: Shipped item is clearance or final sale

outcomes.remedy: No return; offer store credit or carrier contact
outcomes.condition: Shipped item is software, downloadable plan, or clearance

outcomes.remedy: Offer return with return label or refund
outcomes.condition: Shipped item is eligible for return under returns policy

steps.name: Verify order and shipment status
steps.instruction: Look up the order referenced by the customer and confirm whether it has already shipped or is on backorder.

steps.name: Gather item details
steps.instruction: Confirm which item(s) the customer wants to change and the requested new quantity, and whether the item is a power tool, its brand, and whether it is final sale.

steps.name: Evaluate change eligibility policy
steps.instruction: If the order has already shipped or is on backorder, a quantity change cannot be applied to the existing order. Evaluate whether any return path applies to the affected items under the returns policy, noting that Laguna and Sawstop power tools and clearance final-sale items are not returnable.

steps.name: Decide quantity change ruling
steps.instruction: Deny the quantity change request when the order has shipped or is on backorder. If the customer is eligible for a return after failed cancellation, direct them to the returns policy instead of changing the order quantity.

steps.name: Act on ruling and communicate
steps.instruction: Send the customer the denial with the reason and any applicable return option or estimated delivery information; escalate to a supervisor if the customer disputes the ruling.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Deny the quantity change and explain that the order can no longer be modified; offer the returns path if eligible
outcomes.condition: Order has shipped or is on backorder

outcomes.remedy: Deny the quantity change and state that Laguna and Sawstop power tools are non-returnable
outcomes.condition: Order has shipped and item is a Laguna or Sawstop power tool

outcomes.remedy: Deny the quantity change and state that clearance items are final sale and not eligible for return
outcomes.condition: Order has shipped and item is clearance final sale
